purpose: Define each committed DWH changefeed/CDC record as an explicit identity referencing the exact source write, transaction, record/resource and accepted revision transition.

topics.name: DWH Change Record Identity
topics.purpose: Define each committed DWH changefeed/CDC record as an explicit identity referencing the exact source write, transaction, record/resource and accepted revision transition.

semantics.identity_rule: Each machine-significant change record has an explicit change identity.
semantics.source_rule: Change references exact originating write execution and transaction where applicable.
semantics.record_rule: Change references exact source record/resource semantic identity.
semantics.revision_rule: Before/after or predecessor/new accepted revision refs are explicit where available.
semantics.commit_rule: Only committed/eligible mutations become normal changefeed records.
semantics.payload_rule: Changed-field/value payload is inert data and may be full, partial or metadata-only according to declared profile.
semantics.lineage_rule: Change record retains exact source provenance.
semantics.identity_separation: Change identity never replaces record or revision identity.

invariants.rule: DWH changefeeds expose committed mutation evidence as ordered provenance-bearing data/events; subscription delivery never directly executes downstream operations and never replaces the underlying record/revision identities.

hard_gates.condition: uncommitted write emitted as accepted change
change id used as record identity
change type inferred only from payload shape

references.purpose: Change records originate from exact writes.

prose.summary: Define each committed DWH changefeed/CDC record as an explicit identity referencing the exact source write, transaction, record/resource and accepted revision transition.
